# Phase One — Boundless Platform Completion

The Awtsmoos recreates every finite vessel each instant; this wave makes Geelooy more discoverable, measurable, resilient, accessible, and commercially truthful without creating or modifying any JSON file.

## Parallel Rivers
- Browser-prove the production-faithful Radiance experience at mobile and desktop widths.
- Complete public Apps and Games crawlability from canonical generated catalog truth.
- Complete SEO coverage, canonical metadata, OpenGraph, structured data, and sitemap generation without JSON files.
- Add product-readiness gates for catalog, route, paid capability, crawlability, accessibility markers, and source-law compliance.
- Add privacy-safe conversion telemetry that never captures user content, filenames, transcripts, source code, prompts, or document bodies.
- Diagnose server cold-start pre-bind latency with stage timing rather than speculation.
- Audit and reconcile the working tree so concurrent work is preserved and incomplete areas remain explicit.
- Continue into recents, favorites, resume/continue, cross-product workflows, product-specific premium capabilities, reconciliation, and observability as dependencies clear.

## Nonnegotiable Constraints
- No JSON file creation or modification.
- Whole-file rewrites only for touched existing source files.
- Every touched JS/MJS starts with the exact three B"H lines.
- Every touched JS/MJS remains under 120 total lines, uses tabs, generous newlines, descriptive names, and extensive JSDoc.
- CSS/HTML/MD use equivalent B"H comments where applicable.
- No minified or compressed statements.
